speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 【护士站／上午】
en: [Nurses' Station / Morning]

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 早晨的护士站已经忙碌起来。石神千鹤正在核对一叠实习登记资料，桌前站着一名陌生的年轻女孩。
en: The nurses' station is already busy this morning. Chizuru Ishigami is checking a stack of internship registration papers. An unfamiliar young woman stands in front of the desk.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 女孩穿着整洁的护士制服，胸前还没有正式员工的名牌。她抱着一本写满便签的笔记本，面带笑容，却有些紧张地站得笔直。
en: The girl wears a neat nurse's uniform, but does not yet have a permanent staff name badge. Holding a notebook filled with sticky notes, she stands very straight, smiling but a little nervous.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神从文件里抽出一张折得整整齐齐的纸。
en: Ishigami takes a neatly folded sheet of paper from the documents.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「狩谷，这张是什么？」
en: “Kariya, what is this?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「啊，那是我自己整理的资料。」
en: “Oh, that's some information I put together myself.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「正式护士待遇、福利，还有其他医院的比较……？」
en: “Staff nurses' pay, benefits, and comparisons with other hospitals...?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「对！我查了很久，想着既然要实习，当然应该先确认将来有没有机会留下来。」
en: “Yes! I spent ages researching it. Since I'm going to be an intern, I thought I should find out whether I might be able to stay afterward.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神看了她一眼。
en: Ishigami looks at her.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「我并不反对你调查待遇。但这张不需要夹进病区交接资料里。」
en: “I have no objection to your researching pay and benefits. But this doesn't belong among the ward handover documents.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「对、对不起！我刚才整理的时候放错了！」
en: “I-I'm sorry! I put it in the wrong place when I was sorting everything!”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她赶忙接过那张纸，夹回自己的笔记本。看得出来，纸上的字迹和表格都十分工整。
en: She quickly takes the sheet back and slips it into her notebook. The handwriting and tables on it are clearly very neat.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 这时坂口隆司走进护士站。
en: Just then, Ryuji Sakaguchi enters the nurses' station.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「坂口医生，正好。给您介绍一位今天报到的实习生。」
en: “Dr. Sakaguchi, perfect timing. Let me introduce an intern who is starting today.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 女孩立刻转过身，向坂口认真鞠躬。
en: The girl immediately turns toward Sakaguchi and bows carefully.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「初次见面！我是狩谷惠，从今天开始在这里实习。请多关照！」
en: “It's nice to meet you! I'm Megumi Kariya, and I'm starting my internship here today. I look forward to working with you!”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「你好，狩谷。第一天就这么有精神啊。」
en: “Hello, Kariya. You're certainly full of energy for your first day.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「当然！我可是很期待这次实习的。」
en: “Of course! I've really been looking forward to this internship.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「实习从六月一日开始，为期半年。十二月一日进行结束评审。具体工作由护理部安排，先熟悉各部门的日常。」
en: “The internship begins on June first and lasts six months. The final assessment will be on December first. The nursing department will arrange your duties. Start by learning the daily routines in each department.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「是！我已经把发给我的注意事项都读过了。」
en: “Yes! I've already read all the instructions you sent me.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 一旁整理病历的杉村弘子抬起头，微笑着看她。
en: Hiroko Sugimura, who is sorting patient records nearby, looks up at her with a smile.

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「听说你很希望毕业后到我们医院工作？」
en: “I hear you're keen to work at our hospital after you graduate?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「我想毕业以后留下来。」
en: “I'd like to stay after graduation.”

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「这么早就决定了？」
en: “You've already decided?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「嗯。我比较过了，这里的待遇最好。」
en: “Yes. I've compared the offers, and the pay and benefits here are the best.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她停了一下，赶紧补充。
en: She pauses, then hastily adds something.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「……我是说，能学到很多东西！」
en: “...I mean, there's so much I can learn here!”

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「第一句也没什么不能说的。」
en: “There's nothing wrong with what you said the first time.”

speaker: 惠
en: “Huh?”

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「想靠自己的工作挣钱，是很正常的事呀。」
en: “It's perfectly normal to want to earn money through your own work.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 惠的表情明显放松了一些。
en: Megumi visibly relaxes.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「太好了。我还怕第一天说这个，会给前辈留下不好的印象呢。」
en: “That's a relief. I was worried that saying that on my first day would give everyone a bad impression of me.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「家里需要钱，我自己也想早一点独立。既然要努力念书、努力实习，我当然希望以后能有一份待遇不错的工作。」
en: “My family needs the money, and I want to become independent sooner, too. If I'm going to study hard and work hard during my internship, of course I want a well-paying job afterward.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「看来你真的做过不少功课。」
en: “Sounds like you've really done your homework.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「是的！这方面我有信心。」
en: “Yes! I'm confident about that part.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「那么接下来，就看看你在护理工作上做了多少功课。」
en: “Then let's see how much homework you've done on nursing.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 护士站的电话响了。弘子正忙着核对交接材料，惠下意识伸出手，又停下来望向石神。
en: The phone at the nurses' station rings. Hiroko is busy checking the handover documents. Megumi instinctively reaches for it, then stops and looks at Ishigami.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「我可以接吗？」
en: “May I answer it?”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 石神点头。
en: Ishigami nods.

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「先听清楚对方的情况。不确定的事交给负责的人回答。」
en: “Listen carefully to what the caller needs first. If you're unsure about something, leave the answer to the person responsible.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 惠拿起电话。刚才有点窘迫的神情立刻变得认真。
en: Megumi picks up the phone. Her slightly embarrassed expression immediately turns serious.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「您好，这里是护士站，我是狩谷。」
en: “Hello, you've reached the nurses' station. This is Kariya speaking.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「……好的。您慢慢说，我记下来。」
en: “...All right. Take your time. I'll write it down.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她翻开笔记本，在空白页上记录，边听边轻轻点头。
en: She opens her notebook and takes notes on a blank page, nodding gently as she listens.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「您是想确认术前检查的时间，对吗？」
en: “You'd like to confirm the time of your preoperative tests, is that right?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「这个我还不能直接回答您。我先向负责的前辈确认，再请她给您答复，好吗？」
en: “I'm not able to answer that myself yet. May I check with the nurse in charge and have her get back to you?”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 电话那头又说了几句。
en: The person on the other end says a little more.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「嗯，我知道您有些担心。我会把问题转达清楚的。请您稍等。」
en: “Yes, I understand you're worried. I'll make sure your question is passed on clearly. Please hold.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她放下电话，将记好的内容递给弘子。
en: She puts down the phone and hands her notes to Hiroko.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「杉村前辈，这位患者想确认术前检查安排。我记下了她的姓名、病房和问题，但是具体时间我不知道，不能随便回答。」
en: “Ms. Sugimura, this patient wants to confirm her preoperative test schedule. I've written down her name, ward, and question, but I don't know the exact time, so I couldn't just give her an answer.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 弘子接过纸，扫了一眼。
en: Hiroko takes the paper and glances over it.

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「谢谢，记得很清楚。我来联系负责的护士。」
en: “Thank you. These are very clear notes. I'll contact the nurse responsible.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「好！那我下次也这样记录。」
en: “Great! I'll take notes like this next time, too.”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「还有一件事，狩谷。」
en: “One more thing, Kariya.”

speaker: 惠
en: “Yes?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「电话里不懂的事主动确认，这很好。但也不用第一天就把所有工作抢着做完。」
en: “It's good that you took the initiative to check what you didn't know on the phone. But you don't need to rush to do everyone's work on your very first day.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「啊……我是不是太心急了？」
en: “Oh... am I getting ahead of myself?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「有一点。」
en: “A little.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「明白了。我会注意的。」
en: “Understood. I'll be more careful.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她在笔记本上迅速添了一行字。
en: She quickly adds a line to her notebook.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 弘子把一份轮转安排放到她面前。
en: Hiroko sets a rotation schedule in front of her.

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「实习期间会接触不同部门的工作。病房、门诊，还有手术室的护理流程，都需要慢慢熟悉。」
en: “During your internship, you'll experience the work of different departments. You'll gradually learn the nursing routines on the wards, in outpatients, and in the operating room.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「病房、门诊……」
en: “The wards, outpatients...”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她听到“手术室”时，笔尖突然停住。
en: At the words “operating room,” her pen suddenly stops.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「……手术室也要去啊。」
en: “...I have to go to the operating room, too.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「怎么？不喜欢手术室？」
en: “What's wrong? Don't you like operating rooms?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「不是不喜欢。只是……我还没有真正站在旁边看过别人开刀。」
en: “It's not that I don't like them. It's just... I've never actually stood beside someone having an operation.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「学校里的照片我都能看。可是，真的看到的时候……我也不知道自己会怎么样。」
en: “I can look at all the pictures at school. But when I see it for real... I don't know how I'll react.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她努力维持着笑容，手指却不自觉地捏紧了笔记本的边缘。
en: She tries to keep smiling, but her fingers unconsciously tighten around the edge of her notebook.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「如果那时候表现不好，会不会影响实习评价？」
en: “If I don't do well then, will it affect my internship assessment?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「实习评价看的是这半年里你怎样学习和工作，不会只凭第一次的表现决定。」
en: “Your assessment is based on how you learn and work over these six months. It won't be decided by your first attempt alone.”

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「真觉得不舒服就及时告诉前辈。硬撑到连自己都照顾不好，帮不上患者的忙。」
en: “If you really feel unwell, tell a senior nurse right away. Pushing yourself until you can't even look after yourself won't help the patient.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「……好。我记住了。」
en: “...All right. I'll remember that.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她低头又写了一行，重新抬起头。
en: She looks down, writes another line, then raises her head again.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「那我也会继续预习的！昨天我把手术室准备的流程背了好久，总不能白背嘛。」
en: “Then I'll keep studying ahead! I spent ages memorizing the operating room preparation procedure yesterday. I can't let that go to waste.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「有准备是好事。不过真正到了现场，还得学会判断自己的状态。」
en: “Being prepared is good. But once you're actually there, you also need to judge how you're coping.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「是，坂口医生。」
en: “Yes, Dr. Sakaguchi.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 这时，利根川安琪抱着整理好的病历走进护士站。
en: Just then, Ange Tonegawa enters the nurses' station carrying a neatly sorted stack of patient records.

speaker: 安琪
zh_CN: 「石神前辈，病房的记录已经整理好了。接下来还有需要帮忙的吗？」
en: “Ms. Ishigami, the ward records are all sorted. Is there anything else I can help with?”

speaker: 石神
zh_CN: 「正好。安琪，带今天报到的狩谷熟悉一下病房和护士站的动线。」
en: “Good timing. Ange, show Kariya, who is starting today, the routes around the wards and the nurses' station.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 安琪转向惠，露出友善的笑容。
en: Ange turns to Megumi with a friendly smile.

speaker: 安琪
zh_CN: 「你好，我是利根川安琪。以后有不清楚的地方，可以问我。」
en: “Hello, I'm Ange Tonegawa. If there's anything you're unsure about, you can ask me.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「你好！我叫狩谷惠。你看起来跟我差不多大呢。」
en: “Hi! I'm Megumi Kariya. You look about my age.”

speaker: 安琪
zh_CN: 「嗯，我十八岁。」
en: “Yes, I'm eighteen.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「真的？我也是十八岁！」
en: “Really? I'm eighteen, too!”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她忽然看见安琪的正式护士名牌。
en: She suddenly notices Ange's permanent nurse's name badge.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「咦，你已经是正式护士了？」
en: “Oh, you're already a staff nurse?”

speaker: 安琪
zh_CN: 「是，不过我也还有很多东西要学。」
en: “Yes, but I still have plenty to learn.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「这样啊……」
en: “I see...”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她盯着安琪的名牌看了一眼，随即笑起来。
en: She looks at Ange's badge for a moment, then smiles.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「那我可要努力追上你了。半年以后，我也想戴上那种名牌。」
en: “Then I'll have to work hard to catch up with you. In six months, I want to wear a badge like that, too.”

speaker: 安琪
zh_CN: 「那就一起加油吧。先跟我把病房认清楚。」
en: “Then let's both do our best. Come with me and learn your way around the wards first.”

speaker: 惠
en: “Okay!”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 惠抱好笔记本，跟着安琪走向护士站出口。走了两步，又回头向坂口、弘子和石神郑重地鞠躬。
en: Megumi gathers her notebook and follows Ange toward the nurses' station exit. After a couple of steps, she turns back and bows earnestly to Sakaguchi, Hiroko, and Ishigami.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「今天开始，真的请大家多多指教！」
en: “I'm really looking forward to working with all of you, starting today!”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「欢迎来到星见医院。」
en: “Welcome to Hoshimi Hospital.”

speaker: 弘子
zh_CN: 「不用急，一件一件学就好。」
en: “There's no need to rush. Learn one thing at a time.”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「我知道。不过……我已经算过了。」
en: “I know. But... I've already done the math.”

speaker: 坂口
zh_CN: 「算过什么？」
en: “The math for what?”

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「如果能顺利留下来，我和家里的生活都能宽裕很多。为了这个目标，半年我会好好努力的。」
en: “If I can stay here, life will be a lot easier financially for both me and my family. I'm going to work hard for these six months to make that happen.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她说得很认真，随后又恢复了明快的笑脸。
en: She speaks with complete sincerity, then returns to her cheerful smile.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「那么，我去工作了！」
en: “Well then, I'd better get to work!”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 安琪在门口等她。两人并肩离开护士站。
en: Ange waits for her by the door. The two leave the nurses' station side by side.

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 走到门外时，惠悄悄翻了一下轮转表。
en: Once outside, Megumi quietly glances through the rotation schedule.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「安琪……手术室是不是很容易看到血啊？」
en: “Ange... do you see blood very often in the operating room?”

speaker: 安琪
zh_CN: 「嗯，手术室当然会见到。」
en: “Yes. Of course you'll see blood in an operating room.”

speaker: 惠
en: “...I thought so.”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她沉默了一瞬，随即合上笔记本。
en: She falls silent for a moment, then closes her notebook.

speaker: 惠
zh_CN: 「没关系。先把今天学好！」
en: “It's all right. I'll focus on learning what I can today!”

speaker: 旁白
zh_CN: 她加快脚步跟上安琪。护士站里，又响起了日常工作的电话铃声。
en: She quickens her steps to catch up with Ange. Back in the nurses' station, the phone rings again amid the day's work.
